notes.title: NIGHTSTAR: Alliance 1.1 Hotfix +
notes.notes:
[h1]Introducing PHOTO MODE[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/844937409a05597e299e9b2e2d4db68347aa2e35.jpg[/img]

Commander, we have installed state of the art photo journalist equipment on the Bop Utility Bots! Access the command panel using the menu button, then select [b]PHOTO MODE[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/ceb168b0e09e2e78a02ab1a9943755d842341e7b.jpg[/img]

Whilst in [b]Photo Mode[/b] you can move around the battle and observe the events of a singularity time frame!!

We should really use this tech to escape the supremacy... But at least we have [b]PHOTOMODE[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/31eaf4cf7a1c103dafd1ed4f4e905a959fd65abe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hotfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Warship weakpoints appear more often.
[*] Missing achievements added to Hedra and Sovereign.
[*] Missing intro cutscene dialogue now appears correctly.
[*] Hedra mission no longer says "dh".
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 4 - Ship Building
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/98a13c9fd833f38ce7b7168027200b07594da2fe.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/uHpstud]JOIN OUR DISCORD![/url]

Phew! Commander, we have decoded a large technology module. This is a [i]game changer[/i] for the Alliance! I'm running a deeper analysis now. Here's what Engineer Nika was able to decrypt so far: 

[i] Decoding transmission...

1600016-16-7-05.... CODE 000000-4... PILOT BOP UNIT ACTIVATED

[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/77461998041fa38e35c6d0559c29e7cbf03ca124.gif[/img]
[h1]Builder BOP and Pilot Bop[/h1]

Our BOP utility drones have newly installed tactical armaments. Aswell as the Tractor Beam and Clamp Arms, BUILDER BOP now has access to an experimental military shield tech which only last a few seconds, but is the difference between escaping the Supremacy, and having our brains turned to mush. The PILOT BOP has also had improvements to its structural mainframe, PILOT BOP directs weapon and thrust capabilities of the Alliance Battlecruiser.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/48678bd7d77c71b0f80b74296ef8e41f3184b89a.gif[/img]
[h1]Alliance Salvage Operations[/h1]
Our Engineers have retrofitted our large module bays with expansion capabilities. We can now attach crew quarters, armour expansions and large structural modules to the Alliance Battlecruiser. This allows us to expand the capacity of the ship and man more weapons and utilities - Lets get out there and find us some salvage!

[h1]Commander Visor Updates[/h1]
During our escape to the outer rim we ensure the safety of nearby colonies by answering their distress calls. The new upgrades to the visor show the number of colony ship signals remaining in the sector.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/6529c9fec2269a68e3f6b380f8265b03a2e620fe.gif[/img]
[h1]Mission communication protocol improved[/h1]
Communications from distress calls and during warp spooling/exit are now subject to a "need to know" basis. Shorter communications are advised.

[h1]Nuclear signatures detected[/h1]
Scans have revealed a large radiation signature on our route to the outer rim, prepare the armory, reinforce shields and get ready for engagement, Commander.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/ee69456c99616cb78df0e0f622bae84c5787142f.gif[/img]

[h1]Ship Distress Signal Received[/h1]
We have received an urgent support request from a nearby sector, the captain has reported ship wide malfunctions and imminent escape pod evacuation into deep space... we cannot leave them out there Commander, plotting route now.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/80217d0dde2391651326b1f3b6e6294162b01de5.gif[/img]
[h1]Engineers tinkering with the Alliance Arcade Cabinet[/h1]
Our engineers have cooked up some new modes in the Mess Hall Arcade Cabinet, we now have access to Story mode, which is the classic game we know and love, and a NEW and IMPROVED ARCADE MODE, which gives us 3 coins to use as lives - should be a blast Commander!

[h1]Mess Hall Achievement Wall[/h1]
The crew have been comparing their achievements on the arcade machines, and started a wall of fame - they are calling it "Steam Achievements" - something related to the malfunctioning ventilation down there.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/18e074c67a3de2ba37833c70ce9a507ead799d27.gif[/img]
[h1]Update notes:[/h1]

- Added "exit to menu" in game settings.
- Added End of Sector Score UI.
- Added Arcade/Story Meta Data to scores
- Added -story (shows story option - 1 life) can work with -arcade
- Edited mission complexity
- Added Missile bomber mission
- Added Colony Escape Pod Mission
- Added Death rewind for arcade mode (and 3 lives)(edited)
- Added Leviathan Boss
- Extended Chapter 1/2 length (less happening per sector)
- Stopped Grey weapons spawning after certain sectors, only good weapons spawn later in the game
- Added Player profile with kills, sectors, and colonies saved (and level bar to show progression) uses steam image and name
- Removed DISTRESS call after skipping game introduction
- Added INTRO and TUTORIAL buttons to main menu
- Improved scoring to avoid 30million+ scores
- Improved missile explosion effects/hit recognition
- Edited mission text timing and enemy spawning to allow reading of on screen prompts
- Edited end of chapter 1 Hedra cutscene to stop enemies destroying you whilst controls are invalidated
- Edited Ship avoidance behaviour to seek central play area after 6m distance (stops them flying away)
- Edited Bop Meshes to show Pilot/Builder
- Achievements edited and Icons created and added to Steam
- Edited tractor beam trace to box to make it easier to grab objects
- Edited the excape vector to be simpler (this entire game section will updated in the next release)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/b4777c1daea1ed303db9a7a8552eaf259d50965a.gif[/img]
[H1]ROADMAP[/h1][list]
[*]Arcade Config file to allow easy editing of lives and play session settings.
[*]THE HIVE Chapter where players enter the Supremacy fortress and save the commanders held there.
[*]Throwable abilities (like screen-wipe nukes, allied fighter ships and other doomsday style weapons)
[*]Colony ships mobilize during boss scenes (we heard you want colony ships to react to boss encounters, so they will be flying around during boss fights)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/161a435f719ddcb67d270b53142dbb6e327b285e.png[/img]
[h1]HOTFIX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Edit Shield cool down icon position
[*] Decrease the Escape pod mission wave interval
[*] Cap Expansions at 16!
[*] Move the backpack to align to one of the 4 attack fleet positions
[*] Remove the tiny Debris meshes
[*] Fix text "ite" on beacon
[*] Remove collision on Colony ships whilst docking
[*] Make the Expansion Loot trail blue
[*] Fix missing Graveyard achievement
[*] Use "Sequence dialogue" colony missions - so waves spawn after dialogue
[*] Add Short delay after colony missions (in the event that two colony mission happen sequentially
[*] Add laser channel check to BOP shield so he can block lasers
[*] Allow Colony ships to un dock during boss fights and redock after
[*] Fix missing colony mission texture
[*] Patch an issue with infinite shields
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 3 - Colonies
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/6cbd154a8e34523c410cfcd30a5cd03699f142bd.png[/img]
[i]Initiating transmission. Commander, can you hear me?
I'm receiving a signal from multiple sources around the 'verse. It looks like one of our allies have discovered a beacon with some sort of encrypted message. Here's what we managed to translate so far. Scroll to the bottom for the short version![/i]

-----
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/e5ec1b0ff5d6886b1bfae84ce9c28e0bfdb5fe86.gif[/img]

[h1]'Oculus Touch' Controller Model and Settings[/h1]
A new controller option was added, along with angle settings to make controlling the Alliance more comfortable and customization. The Oculus Touch controller will now appear in game when utilizing this system. And make sure to adjust the new Angle Settings for increased comfort!

[h1]Colony Ships' Movement Upgraded[/h1]
The beacon contained a hidden code that we can use to help our allies dock and leave docking correctly. This will fix their forward alignment and will make those tasks feel a lot more natural.

Our ST-3v3 unit also managed to install this new code on its own circuits, and will now leave the system if it loses sight of the Alliance ship.

[h1]Fixed Scores[/h1]
There was a small issue with the score counters, causing scores to be calculated incorrectly. This will no longer happen, as part of this mysterious encrypted code seems to have the correct formulas. I love technology!

This also means all existing highscores will be reset. It's time to jump to the next sector and leave your mark on the leaderboards!

We also installed Advanced Image Preceptors that will allow systems to be visualized with more fidelity. Shiny graphics!

-----

[i]That's it for this mission update! Here's the short version of this, with all the items we managed to decrypt from this weeks' update beacon. See you around the 'verse![/i]

- Added BOP angle in settings
- Added Oculus Touch controller model
- Fixed colony ships not aligning to forward vector during docking and leaving
- Fixed ST-3v3 not leaving game on death
- Fixed exploit during pause for changing modules/charging weapons
- Randomised colony ship exits so that some ships may stay after a level
- Boss mission tweaks
- Removed residual particle effect from bop hand from old scoring visuals
- Edited multiplier to cap at 8x and reset the leaderboards in the interest of fairness
- Added spooling engines to the ships that will leave after sector warp
- Options Save Data
- Mission target enemies highlighted
- Reduced scoring to bring max scores down from over 1-10s of millions
- BOP tractor improvements
- Background generator improvements

-----
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/8cd86c785bf2bb2172a7f1b0081c1442c3f3640e.png[/img]

- Fixed infinite score bug in Sectors 5 and 6
- Fixed score submission issues
- Fixed "missing executable" error

notes.title: Early Access Update 2 - Logistics
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/1fc61f48e5001f707cd981d787c730225a4263e6.png[/img]
[i]Welcome Commander, 
This is Engineer Nika, Since your last excursion there have been several mission critical changes that will affect your next flight. I'm here to guide you through em'.

Commander Ship Signature Located!
Logistics Commander ST-3v3 has been located in a nearby sector - plotting coordinates now!

Primitive Class-B artificial intelligence cores left ST-3v3 unharmed by the nanobot virus which claimed most AI during the rise of The Supremacy. ST-3v3's primary directive is to manage logistics and storage of the colonies inventory. 

If we rendevous and bolster the Alliance, ST-3v3 could help manage our arms and munitions.[/i]

-----

[h1]BOP Utility Bot Upgraded[/h1]
This one was me Commander! 
Me and those down at the engineering bay fashioned a scrapped Mag-Lev Hangar storage module into (if I might be so humble) and extremely effective Tractor Beam upgrade for our BOP Utility Bots! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/05fa3145eebe7e6dafae853c2992d1b92c7418bc.gif[/img]
[i]
All you do is aim directly at the modules floating around during the escape, and pull them in. How's that for a night's work Commander![/i]

---
[h1]Munition Trajectory and Attack confirmation Update[/h1]
Commander, our trajectorial analysis systems for missiles and guided explosives has been improved, visual trails will be much more visible and help with identification of incoming danger!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/8f255280184c75cb73f375d689b02616f41c9f77.gif[/img]
[i]Changes to the on board tactical display have been reverted - improving identification of the accuracy and effectiveness of our attacks on the Supremacy - Multipliers and Ratings will be visualised above destroyed enemies (strangely like in that dream I logged in holodeck that I named "game trailer").[/i]

---
[h1]Supremacy Weakpoint Analysis Improved[/h1]
The targetting and analysis systems for Supremacy weakpoints can now identify direct hits! Our ability to strike the enemy at the most volatile areas has thus improved and it's quite the fireworks display!

----
[i]Mission Updates complete - Let's hit the Rec Room and play some "Pyramid"!

Oh Commander!! Speaking of the Rec Room, Our engineers are working on some sweet improvements to the arcade cabinets down there too! Achievements and save data options for the games UI and configurable tutorials and number of "Lives" are being added to that super classic "Nighstar Alliance" game we scavenged from Terra!

We will let you know when we have those up and running, should be another week![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/cb5b6b2859ffdcda1010eb1a01bf46023805bb55.gif[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Release and Update 1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/b9f6c22fb180cc54f6c69d34d7c79b7150295e4b.gif[/img]

Calling all commanders, we're ready for countdown! We're happy to announce the very first public version of NIGHTSTAR: Alliance is now available on Steam! 

NIGHTSTAR: Alliance is a direct continuation of NIGHTSTAR: Starfighter. This time you control a heavy armed battle cruiser during a daring escape from the evil Supremacy forces. But this time, you're not alone. Build a massive space fleet, upgrade all your ships and get ready to battle in outer space. All of it with that modern revisit to the 80s aesthetics and arcade feel!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32921465/fd587d553a07cef429ff76ecef44e6dfdb6e05d7.gif[/img]

We've had a few weeks of demoing the game in events along with VR Arcades and the media and the following changelog refers to what changed since then. We're looking forward to continue listeting to your feedback and improving the game. 

Changelog

- Engineer Nika has joined the Alliance
Engineer Nika will be commanding the Repair module bay! This helps differentiate between some of the story elements involving Dr Tali and the characters on modules in game.

- New Supremacy Waves Detected!
New baddies are coming, and in greater number! Enemies now have a chance to spawn in formation along with battleships and destroyers. Set all blasters to full power!

- Target Aquisition Improved
Our Blaster tech has improved by a margin of 10-20%, improving bullet flight speed and trajectorial accuracy! Take em for a spin, Commander!

That's it for today! Hope you all enjoy the game, and if you have any comments don't be shy! Jump on our Discord or leave a note on the forums here on Steam and let we know your thoughts!

End of transmission.
